Title: Urkundenbuch zu der Geschichte des Reichstages zu Augsburg im Jahre 1530, herausgegeben von Karl Eduard Forstemann; Zweiter Band: Von der Uebergabe der Augsburgischen Confession bis zu dem Schlusse des Reichstages
Creator: Karl Eduard Forstemann (editor)
Publisher: Halle: Verlag der Buchhandlung des Waisenhauses (title page)
Publication Date: 1835 (title page, read on the page image, leaf n4; the OCR misreads the year as 1839)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1835); the archive.org record carries the Public Domain Mark (licenseurl creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/), and the imprint date agrees; the host record's date of 1833 is the first volume's
Language: deu; lat
Source: archive.org item bub_gb_mx8TAAAAQAAJ, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-15 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (1,728,445) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1835, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: the German black letter is fair; the Latin is fair. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: Documents of the Diet from the handing over of the Confession to the close. A contents list of Nos. 108-308 at about OCR lines 20-830; it names No. 135 (an extract of the German Confutatio), No. 136 (readings of the Latin Confutatio), and a sixth part for 22 September to 19 November. No. 206, the first recess touching the faith, of 22 September, at about 23715; No. 249, the recess of 13 October to the obedient cities, at about 35317; No. 305, a report of the reading of the recess of 19 November, at about 41363, where the editor leaves the recess itself out as well enough known. Single documents were not mapped.

Varianten zu dem fatinifchen Texte der Confessio tetra-

politana. *) 


Diie Reichstags-Acten von 1530 im Kal. Baierifchen Geheimen 
Staats: Archive zu München enthalten P. I. Fol. 835 — 349. eine 
Abſchrift des lat. Tertes der Confessio tetrapolitana unter dem Titel: 


„A°. 80. 
Etliher Reich Stet furbradter 
vergrif des glaubens halb In Latein,“ 


Diefe Abichrift ift wegen ihres Tertes von der hoͤchſten Wichtigkeit 
für die Kritik des Tertes der Conlessio telrapolitana, Die vielen bis— 
her vollig unbekannten wichtigen Varianten, welche dieſe echte Hands 
fchrift darbietet, laflen ung weniaftens vermutben, daß wir hier den 
Zert dieſes Glaubens s Befenntniffes in der Geftalt erhalten, wie es 
dem Katier am 11. Jul 1530 übergeben worden ift. Auf jeden Fall 
ift der Tert in dieier Abſchrift nicht jo vollendet und ausgefeilt, wie 
er in der erjten Ausgabe im Drude erſcheint; es fehlen hier fogar die 
Artikel de confessione Cap. XX. und de magisiratibus cap. XXIII.
